scope: Native gpu_lbvh_find_collision_pairs over bounded validated 3D LBVH inputs
preconditions: Finite normalized poses, validated geometry, bounded counts and correctly sized batch-major scratch and interleaved state
Build consumes stable sorted 30-bit Morton keys and a collider permutation; topology and escape inputs are independently checked
Empty build/leaves/pair traversal and fewer-than-two-leaf refits are skipped by the controller to preserve native unsigned-count preconditions
Refit frontier contains unique valid node IDs; collision groups use native And/Or semantics
invariants: Integer topology, Morton keys, counters, copied words, read-only inputs and untouched capacity storage remain exact
Tree graph covers each sorted leaf exactly once, parent links and ranges agree, and escape links implement depth-first traversal
Leaf AABBs enclose independent shape support; completed internal bounds equal child unions and maximum leaf extent
Frontier order and pair allocation order may differ, but legal membership, uniqueness, total requested counts and capacity guards are exact
CPU executes cooperative phases in order; Metal explicitly fences device and threadgroup memory between refit levels
Morton clamp is evaluated after exact power-of-two scaling to preserve the native value without the compiler truncating its fractional endpoint
outside_scope: Full resident Morton sort/build/refit/traversal composition and production backend integration
Ascend vendor compilation, execution and device-memory synchronization qualification
tolerance_reason: Only leaf world-bound arithmetic uses 2e-6 absolute / 2e-5 relative; all keys, topology and union-only refit arithmetic remain exact. No relaxed Morton-key comparison.
